schema_notes.core_count_note: AMD uses symmetric SMT (2 threads per core). Intel hybrid: P-cores support HT on Raptor Lake and older; Arrow Lake P-cores do NOT support HT.
schema_notes.pcie_lanes_note: CPU-native lanes only. Additional lanes from platform chipset vary by motherboard.
schema_notes.memory_speed_note: Native rated speed listed. EXPO (AMD) and XMP (Intel) overclocking can significantly exceed base spec.
schema_notes.tdp_note: TDP (PL1/Base Power) is primary. Max Turbo Power (PL2/MTP) listed separately — use MTP for PSU budget calculations.
schema_notes.compatibility_note: compatible_chipsets and socket fields power the AI Configurator compatibility engine.

compatibility.notes: Dual-CCD chip — only one CCD has 3D V-Cache. Full overclocking supported (first dual-CCD X3D to support it). Game threads parked on V-Cache CCD automatically.
12-core X3D. Lower TDP than 9950X3D. Excellent creator + gaming balance.
World's fastest gaming CPU at launch. Single-CCD — no scheduling complexity. First X3D with full PBO overclocking support. Under-die cache placement improves thermals and clock headroom vs gen 1.

overclocking: AMD EXPO memory OC only — no manual core OC

compatibility.notes: Previous-gen gaming king. 1st-gen V-Cache on top of die — thermal constraints limit clocks. No manual OC. Excellent value on secondary market.
Best AM5 chip for pure productivity without V-Cache premium. Preferred over 9950X3D for non-gaming AI and rendering workloads — same MT performance, lower cost.

specifications.architecture: Arrow Lake (Lion Cove P-cores + Skymont E-cores)

compatibility.cooler_mount: LGA1851 (same hole spacing as LGA1700 — most LGA1700 coolers compatible with adapter)
compatibility.notes: Arrow Lake removed HT from P-cores — 24 cores = 24 threads only. PCIe 5.0 x16 to GPU is CPU-direct. AVX-512 dropped. Requires new LGA1851 motherboard — not compatible with Z790/Z690.
Best value Arrow Lake. 4 fewer E-cores vs 285K but significantly lower price. Same Z890 platform — board upgrade path available.

memory.subtype: UDIMM (DDR4 or DDR5 — determined by motherboard, not both)

compatibility.recommended_cooler: 360mm AIO — 253W sustained TDP demands premium cooling
compatibility.notes: Final generation on LGA1700. 32 threads via P-core HT + E-cores. DDR4 or DDR5 depends on motherboard — flag mismatch in configurator. Sustained draw is 253W — not 125W.
Highest-clocked consumer Intel CPU ever at 6.2 GHz TVB. Premium-binned silicon. Worth it only for extreme overclocking.
Standout of the Raptor Lake Refresh lineup — gained 4 E-cores vs 13700K. Near i9-14900K gaming performance at much lower cost. LGA1700 final generation.
Functionally near-identical to 14900K. Strong secondary market value. DDR4 or DDR5 motherboard dependent.
8 fewer E-cores than 14700K. Excellent secondary market value for AI inference + mid-range GPU pairing.

pcie.notes: PCIe 4.0 only — critical limit for discrete GPU bandwidth (32 GB/s max vs PCIe 5.0's 64 GB/s)

memory.unified_memory_note: CPU and iGPU share memory pool. Up to 96GB assignable as VRAM.

compatible_form_factors: Mini PC (Minisforum MS-S1, GMKtec EVO-X2, Beelink GTR9 Pro)
Laptop (ASUS ROG Flow Z13, HP OmniBook Ultra)
compatibility.discrete_gpu_compatibility: PCIe 4.0 x16 available on select mini PCs. Discrete GPU works but bandwidth-limited.
compatibility.notes: Killer feature: 128GB unified memory as VRAM — enables 70B+ LLM inference locally. Not a socketed desktop CPU. PCIe 4.0 limits discrete GPU. Best for compact AI inference systems.
12-core Strix Halo. Same 40 CU iGPU and 8-channel 256 GB/s memory as Max+ 395. 4 fewer CPU cores.

pcie.notes: 128 PCIe 5.0 lanes — supports 4x GPUs at x16 each with lanes remaining for NVMe and expansion

compatibility.recommended_cooler: Custom loop or Noctua NH-U14S TR5-SP6
compatibility.compatible_gpu_pcie_gen: PCIe 5.0 x16 (4 full-bandwidth GPU slots native)
compatibility.notes: 8-channel ECC DDR5 requires WRX90 platform exclusively — not compatible with AM5 or TRX50. 128 PCIe 5.0 lanes enables full 4x GPU AI rack config. No iGPU — requires discrete GPU.

compatibility.recommended_cooler: Custom loop or Noctua NH-U14S TR5-SP6
compatibility.notes: 64-core workstation. Same 128 PCIe 5.0 lanes and 8-channel ECC DDR5 as 7995WX. Higher boost clocks than 7995WX due to fewer cores sharing power budget.
PRO platform entry point. Highest boost clock in the 7000 WX series (5.3 GHz) due to fewest cores. Full 128 PCIe 5.0 lanes and 8-channel ECC DDR5 retained.

pcie.notes: TRX50 HEDT platform — 48 PCIe 5.0 lanes only vs PRO's 128. Impacts multi-GPU configs.

compatible_motherboards: ASUS ROG Zenith X Extreme TRX50
compatibility.cooler_mount: sTR5 (same physical socket as WRX90 — coolers cross-compatible)
compatibility.compatible_gpu_pcie_gen: PCIe 5.0 (48 total lanes — max 2x x16 GPU configs)
compatibility.notes: HEDT consumer Threadripper. TRX50 and WRX90 share the sTR5 socket but motherboards are NOT interchangeable. 4-channel DDR5 (not 8) and 48 (not 128) PCIe lanes vs PRO 7985WX. More affordable entry into 64-core territory.

compatible_motherboards: ASUS ROG Zenith X Extreme TRX50
compatibility.notes: Entry-tier HEDT Threadripper. TRX50 platform. 4-channel DDR5 and 48 PCIe 5.0 lanes. Best affordable path into 32-core workstation territory.

ai_capabilities.ai_use: Best budget AM5 CPU for single GPU AI builds — low 65W TDP leaves maximum PSU headroom for the GPU, Zen 5 IPC handles tokenisation and data pipelines efficiently.
ai_capabilities.notes: 6-core Zen 5 punches well above its cost. Ideal for essentials/capable tier builds prioritising GPU spend.

ai_capabilities.ai_use: Entry AM5 AI CPU — pairs well with any mid-range GPU for daily inference and AI-assisted development at a budget price point.
ai_capabilities.notes: Excellent price-performance for essentials-tier builds. Leave headroom for a GPU upgrade later.

ai_capabilities.ai_use: Best value Intel AI CPU — 14 cores handle data preprocessing and CPU-side tokenisation well; LGA1700 socket enables DDR4 or DDR5 board choice for cost flexibility.
ai_capabilities.notes: LGA1700 broadest platform compatibility. Pair with B760 or Z790 board.

ai_capabilities.ai_use: Entry LGA1700 AI CPU — available at street prices well below MSRP; solid Raptor Lake IPC for inference tasks; great with affordable B760 boards.
ai_capabilities.notes: Excellent used/clearance value. DDR4 board option reduces total build cost significantly.

configurator_compatibility_rules_cpu._description: CPU compatibility rules for the AI PC Configurator feature.

socket_rules.am5: Ryzen 7000, 8000, 9000 series. Chipsets: X870E, X870, X670E, X670, B650E, B650, B840, B850, A620. DDR5 only.
socket_rules.lga1700: Intel 12th, 13th, 14th Gen Core. Chipsets: Z790, Z690, B760, H770. Final Intel generation on this socket. DDR4 or DDR5 — determined by motherboard.
socket_rules.lga1851: Intel Core Ultra 200S (Arrow Lake). Chipsets: Z890, B860, H870. DDR5 only. NOT compatible with LGA1700 CPUs.
socket_rules.str5_wrx90: Threadripper PRO 7000. Platform: WRX90 only. DDR5 ECC RDIMM 8-channel. NOT interchangeable with TRX50.
socket_rules.str5_trx50: Threadripper 7000 HEDT. Platform: TRX50 only. DDR5 4-channel. NOT interchangeable with WRX90.
socket_rules.bga_strix_halo: Ryzen AI Max — soldered. Not user-replaceable. OEM system only.

pcie_compatibility.note: Match GPU pcie_version to CPU native gen for full x16 bandwidth. GPU runs at lower gen on older CPU — warn but do not block.
pcie_compatibility.intel_lane_note: Intel consumer CPUs (LGA1700/LGA1851) provide 20–24 native CPU lanes: 16 to GPU + 4 to NVMe. Additional lanes from Z-series chipsets.
pcie_compatibility.amd_am5_note: AMD AM5 provides 24 usable CPU lanes (16 GPU + 4 NVMe + 4 chipset). Multi-GPU on AM5 requires x8/x8 bifurcation or PLX switch.
pcie_compatibility.threadripper_pro_note: Threadripper PRO 7000 provides 128 PCIe 5.0 lanes — enables 4x x16 GPU configs without bandwidth compromise.
pcie_compatibility.threadripper_hedt_note: Threadripper 7000 HEDT (TRX50) provides 48 PCIe 5.0 lanes — max 2x x16 GPU config.

ddr4_or_ddr5: LGA1700 — motherboard determines which — flag mismatch as INCOMPATIBLE
ecc_required: sTR5 WRX90 — requires DDR5 ECC RDIMM — flag standard UDIMM as INCOMPATIBLE

cooler_rules.am5: 105mm x 105mm mounting. AM4 coolers physically compatible with AM5 adapter bracket.
cooler_rules.lga1700: Different physical mounting from LGA1851. Not directly interchangeable without adapter.
cooler_rules.lga1851: Same hole spacing as LGA1700 — most LGA1700 coolers work with included or third-party adapter.
cooler_rules.str5: sTR5 large IHS requires dedicated Threadripper coolers. WRX90 and TRX50 share same cooler compatibility.

power_budget_rules.note: Use max_turbo_power_watts (MTP/PL2) for PSU calculations — not base TDP. Add GPU TDP + 15% headroom for PSU selection.
power_budget_rules.threadripper_warning: Threadripper PRO 7995WX (350W) + 2x RTX 5090 (2x575W) = 1500W minimum draw. Flag builds below 1600W PSU as undersized.

multi_gpu_rules.consumer_am5_lga: Only x8/x8 GPU bifurcation without PLX switch. Flag multi-GPU builds as bandwidth-limited.
multi_gpu_rules.threadripper_pro: Native 4x x16 PCIe 5.0 — full multi-GPU bandwidth. Recommended platform for GPU rack builds.
multi_gpu_rules.threadripper_hedt: Max 2x x16 PCIe 5.0 on TRX50. 3rd GPU would require x8 or PLX switch.
